title: Our Incident Playbook, Published | Pro Link Systems
caption:
Two in the morning is a bad time to learn how your IT partner works.

So we published our incident-response playbook — the one the on-call engineer actually opens. All of it: how we decide, in what order, and who we call.

It's free. No form, no email required.

The time to find out how someone handles a crisis is before the crisis, not during one.

→ Download the free Incident Response Playbook — no form, no email required:
https://prolinksystems.com/incident-response-playbook

→ Book a free 15-minute readiness review:
https://prolinksystems.com/contact

SOME OF WHAT'S IN IT
· Panic is a choice. We stay calm because the next move is already written down.
· Contain, don't erase. Isolate the problem, but preserve the evidence — you will need to know what happened.
· Communicate out-of-band. Never discuss a live incident on a system that may be listening. Verify any payment change by voice.
· Recover from tested backups. An untested backup is not a backup; it's a hope.
· Blameless post-incident review. Every incident we handle makes the playbook better.
· A real person answers, 24/7, in-house — the same team you'd meet at 2 a.m.

The full playbook also covers the NIST SP 800-61 lifecycle, our severity tiers, per-incident-type runbooks and the full communications protocol.

ABOUT PRO LINK SYSTEMS
Pro Link Systems has provided managed IT, cybersecurity, cloud and disaster recovery to Los Angeles businesses since 1999. Our help desk is in-house, US-based and staffed 24/7 — when you call, a person answers. No phone tree, no hold queue. Our average ticket first-response time is 15 minutes, we resolve 90% of issues on first contact, and average resolution is under an hour. We deploy SentinelOne for endpoint detection and response in client environments.

Woodland Hills, California
